name: Meptazinol
summary: Meptazinol, sold under the brand name Meptid, is an opioid analgesic developed by Wyeth in the 1970s. Indications for use in moderate to severe pain, most commonly used to treat pain in obstetrics (childbirth).

pharmacology.text: A partial μ-opioid receptor agonist, its mixed agonist/antagonist activity affords it a lower risk of dependence and abuse than full μ agonists like morphine.

body.says: The peak analgesic effect is seen within 30–60 minutes and lasts about 3–4 hours
The drug is rapidly metabolized to the glucuronide, and mostly excreted in the urine

uses.text: Meptazinol, sold under the brand name Meptid, is an opioid analgesic developed by Wyeth in the 1970s. Indications for use in moderate to severe pain, most commonly used to treat pain in obstetrics (childbirth).

summaryZh: 美普他酚（英語：Meptazinol，商品名有Meptid等）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C15H23NO，屬於合成類阿片物質，1970年代由惠氏公司開發，在產科學中用於緩解分娩疼痛。
summaryZhHans: 美普他酚（英语：Meptazinol，商品名有Meptid等）是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C15H23NO，属于合成类阿片物质，1970年代由惠氏公司开发，在产科学中用于缓解分娩疼痛。

sideEffects.en: Common effects include nausea, vomiting, dizziness and drowsiness. Like other opioids it can slow breathing and lead to dependence, though this is thought to be less likely than with full opioid agonists such as morphine.
sideEffects.zh: 常見作用包括噁心、嘔吐、頭暈與嗜睡。和其他鴉片類一樣，它可能使呼吸減慢並導致依賴，不過一般認為風險低於嗎啡等完全致效劑。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见作用包括恶心、呕吐、头晕与嗜睡。和其他鸦片类一样，它可能使呼吸减慢并导致依赖，不过一般认为风险低于吗啡等完全致效剂。

fact.en: Meptazinol has an unusual seven-membered ring containing nitrogen, and besides acting on opioid receptors it also boosts acetylcholine signalling, which may add to its pain relief.
fact.zh: 美普他酚帶有一個罕見的含氮七元環，除了作用於鴉片受體之外，它還會增強乙醯膽鹼訊號，這可能增加它的止痛效果。
fact.zhHans: 美普他酚带有一个罕见的含氮七元环，除了作用于鸦片受体之外，它还会增强乙酰胆碱信号，这可能增加它的止痛效果。
